connect_analytics.daily.caption: Connect operational report by complete UTC day, with the range total in the final row
connect_analytics.daily.footnote: Percentiles are per day and are never averaged into a range percentile; "n" is the population behind them. Assigned to resolved is wall-clock elapsed time, not active handle time.
connect_analytics.daily.title: Daily breakdown (UTC)
connect_analytics.empty.description: Either Connect saw no traffic on these days, or aggregation has not run for them yet. The Connect metrics page can rebuild them.
connect_analytics.empty.title: No aggregated days in this range
connect_analytics.errors.load: Could not load the operational report
connect_analytics.nav.title: Connect analytics
connect_analytics.page.description: Read-only operational reporting over complete UTC days. Rebuilding aggregates stays on the Connect metrics page.
connect_analytics.range.explainer: Day boundaries are UTC and today is excluded, because a partial day cannot reconcile. Reporting is read-only: rebuilding aggregates stays on the Connect metrics page.
connect_analytics.unavailable.descriptio: Connect did not answer, so there is no report for this range. This is not a report of zero activity.
connect_analytics.unavailable.title: Operational metrics are unavailable
